اصطلحا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَلَحَا (iṣṭalaḥā) /isˤ.tˤa.la.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# اُصْطُلِحَا (uṣṭuliḥā) /usˤ.tˤu.li.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# اِصْطَلِحَا (iṣṭaliḥā) /isˤ.tˤa.li.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
